meta.description: FIVClínic — Advanced fertility and IVF clinic in Barcelona, part of Hospital Clínic Barcelona. World-class fertility care for international patients.

hero.eyebrow: Advanced fertility and IVF clinic in Barcelona
hero.titleTail: in a leading medical destination in Europe
hero.lead: Barcelona is not only a premier travel destination, it is a place patients from around the world choose for high-quality, specialized medical care.
paragraphs: At FIVClínic, we provide personalized fertility treatment and expert guidance for complex cases, supported by the clinical environment of Hospital Clínic Barcelona.
Whether you are exploring treatment options, seeking a second opinion, or planning your fertility journey from abroad, our team is here to guide you with clarity, care, and expertise.
hero.note: FIVClínic is the assisted reproduction department of barnaclínic+, backed by Hospital Clínic Barcelona — an internationally ranked, tier-1 university hospital group.

supportFaq.titleAccent: Barcelona from elsewhere in Spain or abroad
paragraphs: We understand that fertility treatment sometimes needs to be planned around work, travel, family logistics, or life in another city or country.
FIVClinic+ offers a structured process that can begin with specialist guidance and coordinated planning.

faqs.q: Can I start the process before traveling?
faqs.a: Yes. The first step can begin with expert consultation and fertility assessment planning, so you can understand your options before organizing treatment travel.

faqs.q: Will I know which treatment is best before coming to Barcelona?
faqs.a: In many cases, yes. Initial evaluation and medical review can help clarify whether insemination, IVF, or shared motherhood should be explored first.

faqs.q: Who will support me during treatment?
list: Professionals experienced in donor sperm treatment and IVF
Staff used to caring for patients who may need remote planning before treatment
